preservedFailures.description: Missing env.emscripten_get_now import; Node additionally waits on native workers during JS process.exit and hits the outer deadline.
Missing wasi_snapshot_preview1.fd_write in the uncaught-exception path.
Negative harness omitted the positive baseline LEAN_STACK_SIZE_KB; rejected before the intended mismatch. Repaired by retaining the recorded stack environment.

ownedProcessFailureControl.scope: Intentional private-runner assertion failure must terminate its owned process promptly; no Lean source/test changes

stdioControls.scope: Byte integrity, memory64 pointers above 4 GiB, invalid ranges with no side effects, sink write counts/errors, empty output and explicit unknown descriptors; synthetic sink controls do not prove native descriptors

limitations: Private repository helper only: no managed installed Wasmtime backend, deployment isolation or six-platform packaging claim.

General imports, runtime metadata/dynamic linking, all WASI descriptors, descriptor redirection and native write errors remain unfinished. Captured stdout/stderr are the only fd_write sinks validated here.
Current helper transfers are bounded to 64 MiB; generalized event-loop keepalive, cancellation, embedded reusable Store disposal and adaptive stack sizes remain open.
Native _Exit is used only by an owned standalone diagnostic process after synchronous output; it is not library-level cleanup.
This partial ordinary IO/exception evidence is separate from full latest-release suite and API acceptance. No remaining gap is demonstrated fundamental.
